report:
Liver, random, biopsy

Sections show two cores of liver measuring 22 mm in aggregate length, with 14 portal tracts. The portal tracts contain a mild mixed inflammatory infiltrate including eosinophils, without interface hepatitis. There is mild lobular inflammation. There is a ductular reaction, canalicular cholestasis and hepatocellular cholestasis. Reticulin stain shows no fibrosis. Perls stain shows no stainable iron. CK7 highlights a ductular reaction.

LIVER, random, biopsy - CHOLESTATIC HEPATITIS, compatible with DRUG-INDUCED LIVER INJURY

Please correlate with clinical findings and the drug and herbal medicine history.
